text.title: Portfolio EVM Rollup Method — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from per-project ledger exports to a signed rollup: fix one data date and stale-flag late ledgers, record contract type and EV method per project, compute the full per-project table with a named EAC formula, sum currency (discrete apart from LOE) into portfolio SPI / CPI, print any weighting beside the unweighted figures, pull the three-period trend, apply the stated thresholds and write narratives only beyond them, then the money block and the owner's signature before the executive review.

step.name: fix-data-date-and-collect-ledgers
step.input: The executive review date; one week-grain PV / EV / AC ledger export per project (CSV or JSON) with its export timestamp; the reporting period (week, fortnight, month).
step.action: Set `data_date` to the last period end before the review and `reporting_period`. Record `ledger_file` and `ledger_exported_at` per project. Any project whose latest ledger entry is older than `data_date` by more than one period goes to `stale_projects[]` with its `bac`, `last_data_date` and export timestamp.
step.decision-gate: Fewer than 3 projects left with a current ledger: stop and report per 06; do not copy last period's values forward (r-single-data-date, fm-02).

step.name: record-contract-type-and-ev-method
step.input: Each project's contract (fixed-bid, time-and-materials, internal) and the EV technique its ledger uses.
step.action: Set `contract_type` and `ev_method` per row. A fixed-bid row earns EV on accepted milestones or deliverables at contract value (`milestone-weight`, `0/100`, `50/50`) and carries `contract_value`. Mark `level-of-effort` rows; they stay out of the discrete aggregate.
step.decision-gate: A fixed-bid ledger reporting self-assessed percent complete is restated on milestones before it enters the table (r-normalise-contract-types, fm-03).

step.name: compute-per-project-table
step.input: PV, EV, AC and BAC per project as of `data_date`, converted to the one reporting `currency`.
step.action: Fill every row: SV = EV - PV, CV = EV - AC, SPI = EV / PV, CPI = EV / AC, EAC by the named `eac_formula` (`BAC/CPI`, `AC+(BAC-EV)/(CPI*SPI)`, or `bottom-up` flagged as such), VAC = BAC - EAC, and for fixed-bid rows `implied_margin` = contract_value - EAC. Use `templates/skeleton.json` as the row shape.
step.decision-gate: A row missing any field, or an EAC that does not agree with its named formula, is rejected by `scripts/validate-portfolio-evm-rollup-method.py` (r-per-project-table-fields).

step.name: sum-currency-into-portfolio-indices
step.action: Sum BAC, PV, EV, AC of the non-LOE rows into `aggregate.discrete`; portfolio SPI = sum(EV) / sum(PV), CPI = sum(EV) / sum(AC), EAC = sum of row EACs, VAC = BAC - EAC. Sum the LOE rows separately into `aggregate.loe`.
step.decision-gate: Any SPI or CPI produced by averaging row indices, simple or weighted, is discarded (r-rollup-sums-currency-not-indices, fm-01).

step.name: print-weighting-beside-unweighted
step.input: The portfolio weighting policy document, if the owner applies one.
step.action: Set `weighting.policy`. For anything but `currency-sum`, cite `weighting.policy_document`, put `weight` on every row, and compute `aggregate.weighted` (SPI, CPI, EAC from weighted sums) next to the unweighted `aggregate.discrete`.
step.decision-gate: No policy document: report `currency-sum` only (r-weighting-policy-declared, fm-04).

step.name: pull-three-period-trend
step.input: The two previous rollups, or the ledgers re-read at the two previous data dates.
step.action: Fill `trend[]` per row and for the aggregate with at least the last three data dates; the last point equals the current SPI / CPI.
step.decision-gate: A project with fewer than three data dates is shown with its available history and named as new in the narrative; a snapshot-only rollup is rejected (r-trend-three-periods, fm-06).

step.name: apply-thresholds-and-write-narratives
step.action: Record `variance_thresholds` with `policy_source`. For every row beyond a threshold write `variance_narrative` with one line of cause and one of corrective action; delete narrative from rows inside. List the rows beyond in `executive_summary.escalated_projects`.
step.decision-gate: Thresholds not stated, or prose on a row inside them, blocks the artefact (r-variance-thresholds-named, fm-05).

step.name: money-block-and-owner-sign-off
step.input: The aggregate, the fixed-bid rows, the portfolio owner.
step.action: Fill `executive_summary`: `bac` and `eac` = discrete + LOE, `vac`, `fixed_bid_margin_total` = sum of fixed-bid `implied_margin`. Run `scripts/validate-portfolio-evm-rollup-method.py --file`. The portfolio owner reviews and sets `owner_sign_off` before `executive_review_date`.
step.decision-gate: Indices without the money block, or an unsigned rollup, does not go to the executive review (r-eac-and-margin-in-money, fm-07, 03 human checkpoint).

list.item: Rollup validates via `scripts/validate-portfolio-evm-rollup-method.py` with no violation.
Every row shares `data_date`; stale projects are listed apart with their BAC.
Portfolio SPI / CPI recompute from the currency sums of the table.
